subject: General Knowledge
topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The city of AGRA is on the banks of:
questions.explanation: Agra — Yamuna. Other Yamuna cities: Delhi, Mathura, Allahabad (where Yamuna joins Ganga). Chambal is Yamuna's tributary. Varanasi is on Ganga. Jabalpur is on Narmada.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the CITY with its RIVER. A. Ahmedabad.  B. Srinagar.  C. Hyderabad.  D. Guwahati. List-II: 1. Sabarmati.  2. Jhelum.  3. Musi.  4. Brahmaputra.
questions.explanation: Ahmedabad — Sabarmati. Srinagar — Jhelum (via Dal Lake). Hyderabad — Musi. Guwahati — Brahmaputra.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The city of JABALPUR is located on the banks of:
questions.explanation: Jabalpur (MP) — Narmada. Famous for Bhedaghat marble rocks + Dhuandhar falls on Narmada. Other Narmada cities: Hoshangabad, Bharuch (mouth). Tapi/Tapti flows through Surat.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the CITY with its RIVER. A. Pune.  B. Nasik.  C. Kanpur.  D. Lucknow. List-II: 1. Mula + Mutha.  2. Godavari.  3. Ganga.  4. Gomti.
questions.explanation: Pune — confluence of Mula and Mutha. Nasik — Godavari (origin at Trimbakeshwar nearby). Kanpur — Ganga. Lucknow — Gomti (Ganga tributary).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The city of VIJAYAWADA is on the banks of:
questions.explanation: Vijayawada — Krishna river. Prakasam Barrage here. Amaravati (new capital of AP) also on Krishna. Rajahmundry (AP) is on Godavari.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Which city is known as the 'ROME OF THE EAST' and is situated on the banks of the Vaigai river?
questions.explanation: Madurai (Tamil Nadu) — situated on the Vaigai river. Sometimes called 'Rome of the East' for its long history (>2500 years). Thanjavur and Trichy are on the Kaveri.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Indian cities on rivers — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The city of BHOPAL (MP) is situated on the banks of:
questions.explanation: Bhopal — City of Lakes. Built around the 11th-century Bhopal Upper Lake (Bada Talab) and Lower Lake (Chhota Talab). NOT a 'river city' per se, despite the MP state being known for the Narmada/Tapi. Kolans river lies nearby but Bhopal is defined by its lakes. no major river, not on the Narmada either.
